verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair axis for a full-stack web framework, but the evidence pack documents no built-in scheduled tasks, background jobs, or autonomous automation runner in Next.js. API routes for listening to webhooks and the MCP endpoint for coding agents are adjacent features, not autonomous background automations. One community comment describes Next.js as fitting apps with "no background jobs," which points the same way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
